description: Clean and inspect a URL without visiting it: strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, mc_eid, _hsenc and many more, grouped by network), unwraps redirect wrappers whose destination is in the address itself (Outlook Safe Links, Proofpoint URL Defense v2 and v3, Google /url?q=, Facebook l.php, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, Slack, Tumblr) and checks the address for phishing signs: punycode and mixed-script hosts, brand names in subdomains, embedded user:pass@, IP hosts, data: and javascript: schemes, risky TLDs, link shorteners, double encoding and overlong paths. Returns the clean link, what was removed, the real registrable domain, a list of warnings and a verdict (clean, caution or avoid). It cannot know where a shortener goes or whether a site is malicious; no DNS or HTTP requests are made. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/link-cleaner/
